anomalies.description: A physical confrontation escalates between two men: one in a black tank top (Han) and one in a white t-shirt (Dom), culminating in a punch thrown by Han at ~30.0s and a counter-strike by Dom at ~30.5s.
A bald man in a white t-shirt engages in aggressive physical combat, lunging forward and striking an opponent; motion blur and body positioning indicate active mutual combat.
After the initial fight, the surrounding crowd erupts into chaotic group scuffles; multiple individuals are seen grappling and shoving in a disorganized melee, indicating collective violent unrest.

The bald man in the white shirt is shown pinning or subduing another person on the ground (visible in f8 and f12), with the victim appearing helpless and face-down while the aggressor maintains control—consistent with abuse rather than mutual combat.

The bald man rises and resumes aggressive posture, shouting and moving toward others amid a chaotic crowd; background figures are engaged in scuffling (e.g., raised fist in f14), indicating renewed mutual combat.

A physical fight erupts in a crowd: a bald man in a white shirt is seen being struck and falling (f1–f4), while others engage in close-quarters combat (f5–f6). The sequence shows active mutual physical engagement, including grappling and striking.

A person is on the ground (f7–f8) while another individual leans over them in an aggressive posture; the grounded person appears unable to defend themselves, suggesting abuse rather than mutual combat.

A large, agitated crowd surges violently around central figures (f9–f14); multiple individuals shout, push, and raise fists simultaneously, indicating collective violent unrest beyond isolated fighting.

A large crowd becomes increasingly agitated and erupts into collective violent unrest, with shouting, surging, and coordinated aggression against individuals and security, escalating into widespread brawling and chaos.
A security officer is tackled and pinned to the ground by multiple individuals (f15), involving direct physical force and restraint—consistent with mutual or asymmetric combat in a chaotic setting.
A man is pinned on the ground by multiple assailants and security officers while being struck; he appears unable to defend himself, indicating abuse of a helpless victim during the melee.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat, including punching, grappling, and tackling, with security personnel intervening. The fight involves at least three distinct pairs/groups actively exchanging blows and struggling on the ground.
A multi-person physical altercation involving several men, including security personnel, with grappling, punching, and takedowns occurring in a crowded outdoor setting.

A bald man in a white shirt is engaged in mutual physical combat with another individual, throwing a punch while surrounded by onlookers; the motion blur and facial expressions indicate active fighting.

An injured man (bruised face, cut lip, sweating) is shown in close-up, appearing dazed and vulnerable, consistent with having just been attacked and being in a helpless state; no active attacker visible in these frames, but context from prior frames supports abuse.
